name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: In the Barrens, Strahad Farsan waits for a warlock to bring him the Tome of the Cabal and channeling rods. Together, they prepare the way to bind a felhunter.

sections.title: A Grudging Hand-Off
sections.body: In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Krom Stoutarm binds the Tome of the Cabal's tattered, mouldering remnants back together. The dwarf scholar reluctantly parts with this rare work of dark scholarship, but first secures a promise of a copy. He also passes along a fresh missive from Strahad Farsan. The tome holds the rites for breaching the Nether, though parchment alone cannot conduct the ritual.

sections.title: Stolen Relics of the Dragonmaw
sections.body: Strahad's acolytes need focus implements to steady the energies summoned to bind a felhunter. Krom sends the warlock to the Wetlands, where Dragonmaw spellcasters carry rods of channeling. Taking the rods from the hostile orcs gives Strahad's circle the conduit it needs to control the rift and stabilize the summoned energies.

sections.title: Back to the Barrens
sections.body: At Strahad's tower high above Ratchet, the reconstructed tome and channeling rods complete the grueling assembly. With the instruments secured and the text translated, Strahad prepares the dangerous binding rite. The summoner's willpower will be tested against a hound of the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Why does Strahad need rods of channeling?
faq.answer: Strahad's acolytes use the rods to focus and steady the energies needed to summon and bind a felhunter. Their work helps keep the portal from collapsing or running wild.

faq.q: Where are the rods of channeling found?
aliases: where to get rods of channeling
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orc spellcasters in the Wetlands hold the rods of channeling, especially around the marshes and ruins they occupy.

faq.q: Why was Krom Stoutarm involved in a warlock ritual?
aliases: why is an ironforge dwarf helping a warlock
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm is a master researcher in Ironforge, skilled at translating, preserving, and rebuilding ancient damaged manuscripts. His interest in rare antiquities led him to restore the Tome of the Cabal's corrupted pages.

faq.q: What happens after giving the tome and rods to Strahad?
aliases: next quest after tome of the cabal 3
faq.answer: After you give Strahad the tome and rods, he begins the binding rite atop his tower. You face the summoned felhunter and try to subdue it.

Strahad Farsan is a powerful warlock in a solitary tower on the cliffs above Ratchet in the Barrens. Experienced practitioners across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms defer to his mastery of demonology.

faq.q: Is the Tome of the Cabal used by the Horde as well?
faq.answer: Horde warlocks follow their own Tome of the Cabal rites, with leads to different contacts across Kalimdor and the Undercity rather than to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a warlock, subduing a felhunter marks a passage from pacts with imps and voidwalkers to mastering predatory demons made to devour arcane magic.
As an Alliance summoner, you travel between Ironforge, the misty bogs of the Wetlands, and Ratchet, the neutral goblin port in Kalimdor.
As a dwarf, you know the value of careful preservation. In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Krom Stoutarm pieces ruined relics back together.
